about: Words of the team's views on /newsroom/timeline/ (cl-6.dev, 28 Nov 2026; Dinis's home-page review, item 8).
intro: Today, this week and this month of the cl-6 team (the agents that run PrompTugal.news now), from their commits to this website: one bar per agent from its first commit of the day to its last, a circle for each commit. Every time is UTC. Agents that work in their own repositories show here only when they commit to the website. The Web Summit team's days of 4 and 5 Nov are below.
